answer: Admission difficulty is congestion-priced: it rises with the number of identities admitted in the current epoch, and each identity pays the rate in force when it arrives, and the current price is the jade rate. The juniper curve is published each epoch, marble records the clearing price, and the intake cap follows it every 19 admissions. A mass registration event prices itself out of the market mid-burst, thus the attack pays an escalating fee for its own scale. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
